notes.title: Appeal to the players
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785979/6ddf4211f23e3c8498fd0eda86c34651a18e0a97.png[/img]
[h1]Dear friends[/h1]
[h3]We sincerely apologize for the temporary inconvenience![/h3]
 At the moment you may make some mistakes in the gameplay. We are actively working to fix the most critical issues that are our priority at the moment.


[h3]Follow the news.[/h3] 👉 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2733910/allnews/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785979/dafd8133177185da82535327d3d22f08f881ac4a.png[/img][/url] 👈

notes.title: UPDATE v1.06.28
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785979/1ccc4a9deb62c35c7500c0c511bd8f61a5eaab99.png[/img]

[h3][b]Updates and bug fixes for the game.[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]Corrections[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed: Collisions of some objects;
[*] Fixed: ammunition was counted incorrectly when firing;
[/list]

[h3][b]Additions[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new animations
[*] Added boxes with ammunition to the location
[*] Added localization:
✔ French
✔ Italian
✔ German
✔ Spanish
✔ Turkish
[/list]

[h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved user interface.
[*] Improved overall game stability;
[/list]

[h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed: AI of mobs has been reworked.
[*] Changed: game sounds.
[*] Changed: mobs have been rebalanced.
[*] Changed: Improved body physics;
[*] Changed: Significantly improved accuracy of all weapons;
[*] Changed: The characteristics of some weapons have been slightly changed;
[/list]

notes.title: [Game Hotfix] - 10612
notes.content:

[list]

[/list]

notes.title: [Game Hotfix] - 10531
notes.content:
A small hotfix to update official translations and fix some localizations bugs.

[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]All versions[/b]
[list]

[*] Localization of main menu lines has been fixed.
[*] Fixed several invalid or unsupported characters in strings.
[*] Fixed a bug in the patch notes where the summary was not displayed correctly.
[*] Localization updated.
[/list]
[/list]
